title: Speech of President Arroyo during the Infant and Young Child Feeding Orientation [Filipino]
text:
Talumpati ng Kagalang-galang Gloria Macapagal-Arroyo Pangulo ng Pilipinas Sa oryentasyon ng Infant and Young Child Feeding

[Ipinahayag sa Manila Hotel, ika 17 ng Disyembre, 2007]

Thank you very much, Secretary Duque. Dr. …. of the World Health Organization; Dr. from UNICEF, Bernie Flores of NNC, chiefs of hospital; chiefs of medical professional services, participants from private hospitals:

Nagtitipun-tipon tayo ngayon upang protektahan at alagaan ang ating pinakamahalagang yaman: ang ating mga bata. Nagkakaisa ang ating pamahalaan, lipunang sibil at pribadong sektor sa likod ng pinakamahalagang isyu sa ating panahon: kung papano maka-ahon sa kahirapan.

Sa araw na ito, ang Manila Declaration on Infant and Young Child Feeding ay lumilikha ng isang hakbang upang wakasan ang paggutom at handugan ng malusog na panimula ang mga bata.

A strong and healthy child is as valuable as a strong a healthy nation.

Naglalayon ang infant and child feeding na punuin ang ating mga bata ng pag-asa. Kailangan ng bawat bata ang “healthy start” o malusog na simula ng buhay. Kaya sabi ko kay Secretary Duque itong mga programa sa loob ng declaration tawagin nating healthy start o malusog na simulang programang IYCF.

Tayo ay gumawa ng mahihirap na desisyon para makalikom ng bagong buwis upang ang pinakamahihirap nating mga bata ay hindi magutom. Sa salaping ating kinikita ng ating bansa tayo ay makakatulong na palakihin ang ating mga anak sa pagkaing wasto at masustansiya.

Over the next three years, ang ating plano ay ihatid ang mga biyaya ng malakas at matatag na ekonomiya sa mga mamamayan. Wala nang mas mahalaga kaysa mamuhunan sa kalusugan at kapakanan ng ating mga bata sa pamamagitan nitong infant and young child feeding, o “malusog na simula.”

Kailangan nating gawin ang lahat ng nasa ating kapangyarihan bilang isang lipunan, pamahalaan at indibiduwal na mamamayan upang alagaan ang ating kinabukasan. At ang ating kinabukasan ay ang mga bata.

Sa ating paglilibot sa ating bansa, nakakausap natin ang mga ina at mga ama na ang tanging hiling ay mabigyan ang kanilang mga anak ng mga pagkakataong hindi sila nagkaroon. Ang ating “malusog na simula” o healthy start program ay hakbang tungo sa katuparan ng mga pangarap na yan.

Ang ating adhikain na maitayo ang iisang Pilipinas ay nagsisimula sa pagtitiyak na ang ating mga anak ay mabigyan ng healthy start of malusog na simula.

Bilang nakatatanda sa kanila, may pananagutan tayo sa mga bata sa buong pilipinas na tiyakin na ang kanilang mga pangunahing panganga- ilangang pagkain ay matugunan upang sila ay makapag-ambag ng tama sa katatagan ng ating bansa.

Infant and Young Child Feeding, na tatawagin na nating “malusog na simula,” is a component of a broader accelerated hunger mitigation program.

We continue to face the challenge of cutting the incidence of hunger.

Last year, we formulated a plan to cut hunger, it is centered on low-cost food, food aid, roadworks and rural building jobs, family farms, microfinance and regional wage adjustments.

The hunger mitigation program framework proceeds from the recognition that hunger is caused by (1) unavailable or insufficient food to eat and (2) no money to buy food.

Therefore hunger mitigation consists of supply and demand measures.

On the supply side, the program is (1) to increase food production and enhance efficiency of logistics and food delivery. On the demand side, the program is (1) to put more money in poor people’s pockets, (2) promote good nutrition and (3) promote natural family planning.

Let me share with you the elements of this framework: to increase food production, the emphasis is on productivity programs including livestock, crops, regeneration of mangrove and coastal fishery, farm family or (gulayan ng masa) and irrigation.

Kahapon nagsimbang gabi kami sa Smokey Mountain at dun inagurahan yung kanilang green house yung kanilang gulayan ng masa kung saan tinatanim nila lahat ng ingredients ng pinakbet.

To enhance efficiency of logistics and food delivery, we have:

A) The Barangay Food Terminals. Eto yung mga bagsakan na nilalagay natin sa mahihirap na lugar. Halimbawa sa smokey mountain maglalagay tayo ng bagsakan sa tabi ng ilog para yung mga barge na nanggaling sa palawan ibat-ibang lugar ng mimaropa ay papasok sa ilog at ibabagsak na lang doon sa river banks sa smokey mountain.

B) At saka yung Tindahan Natin. So gaya nang sabi ko yung Barangay Food Terminal bagsakan ito in the areas thickly populated by the poor. Whereas yung Tindahan Natin ay parang sari-sari store actually sari-sari store ang itsura pero specialty store ang concept. Makakabili dito ng murang bigas at noodles na kinakain sa araw araw.

Inuna nating ipinatayo ang mga ito sa mga lugar kung saan maraming nakakaranas ng gutom. Ngayon ay mayroon nang halos walong libong Tindahan Natin outlets natin sa bansa.

Yung logistics kasama dito nandun din yung roll-on- roll-off ferry ports kasi mas mura yun kaysa yung mga sinasakay sa narko ang pagkain. Sinasakay na lamang yung delivery truck. Tapos pinapabuksan din natin yung mga private ports saka private shipping. Sa ganun mas marami. When you have big supply of ports, you have lower prices … Kumpetensya sa isa-isa.

Tapos yung farm to market roads para mura ang transportasyon mula sa sakahan hanggang sa palengke.

At saka yung efficient local transport at the local government level. Pinapaalala natin yung mga local government units ay walang kapangyarihang mag kolekta ng mga fees sa mga truck na dumadaan lamang sa kanila.

And then we have the food for school program of the national government, kung saan binibigyan ng isang kilong bigas ang mga pre-school, day care at grade one sa mga food poor areas para iuwi sa kanilang pamilya.

Dapat nating busugin ang mga puso at isipan ng ating mga bata sa pamamagitan ng biyaya ng edukasyon, subali’t bago mangyari ito, kailangan muna nila ang busog na tiyan.

Dapat harapin ng ating mga bata ang bawat araw na masaya, malusog at puno ng pag-asa. Dapat panabikan nila lamang ang karunungan at hindi ang pangunahing kailangan ng pagkain.

Layunin din ng programang ito na mabigay ng wastong pagkain sa pamamagitan ng early childhood care and development system, sang ayon sa Early Childhood Care and Development Law na mukhang nakakalimutan natin ma-implement.

The ECCD system includes nutrition service programs that provide for the needs of young children from birth to age six.

One of its objectives is to achieve improved infant and child survival rates by ensuring that adequate health and nutrition programs are accessible to young children and their mothers from the pre-natal period throughout their early childhood years.

Bagamat hindi pa natin fully implemented ito, with what we have been achieving so far, we are gratified that according to the millennium development goals monitor, the child mortality rate has been reduced from 40/1000 live births. Now, we are down to 32/1000. And we’re very much on track with the millennium development goal to reduce it to 27/1000 by 2015. Congratulations to all of you involved in child nutrition! (applause)

Ang pagkakaloob ng sustansiya sa mga bata na kung hindi ay gugutumin ang pinakamahalagang bagay na magagawa ng ating bansa. Ito ay kagandahang asal, panglipunang pangangailangan at kagalingang pangkabuhayan.

In our hunger mitigation program, we also create an NGO network to support feeding programs.

And we also have now given the farmers’ option to buy back the rice they sell the NFA if they can get a higher price outside from the traders.

Now on the other side, the demand side: to put more money in poor people’s pockets, the program includes:

First, improve productivity in coconut areas by promoting coconut coir, virgin coconut oil and other value-added products, and coconut production. Kasi ang pinakamahihirap na magsasaka atin ay yung mga magniniyog.

Second, more aggressive microfinancing.

Third, maximize employment in the construction and maintenance of farm-to- market roads, irrigation and road maintenance. Ewan ko kung nakikita niyo pag kayo ay dumadaan sa kalsada yung mga naka asul na tshirt na naglilinis linis dyaan sa mga shrubs yan ang mga tinatawag nating oyster out-of-school-youth. At yan ay para nga magkaron ng income yung kanilang pamilya.

At aggressive training importante .. Natin para maging competitive tayo.

And then, upland land distribution for jatropha and rubber.

And of course, to promote good nutrition, the program includes the following:

Conducting social marketing, of which this orientation is a part.

Nutrition education in schools.

And promoting breastfeeding, appropriate complementary feeding until two years of age, and increased consumption of vegetables. The promotion of breastfeeding for children up to two years old, with emphasis on exclusive breastfeeding for the infant’s first six months, is our fundamental approach to reduce if not eliminate hunger among infants and the very young children.

There is no substitute for mother’s milk, as most Filipinos know, but this knowledge has not been translated into practice. Our data indicate that more and more mothers are weaning their infants from breastmilk after only one month. A mere 16% of infants remain exclusively breastfed at 4-5 months, and very few are nourished by mothers’ milk up to 2 years old. We must act, and act fast to ensure that the nation builders of the future are provided proper nourishment.

One immediate concern which is why we’re having this is to involve all 1,426 accredited mother-baby friendly hospitals to fully implement the rooming in and breastfeeding act, the milk code and other laws on providing proper nourishment for infants. We need the strong will to make hospitals uphold our laws and work even harder to encourage other hospitals to join in our campaign.

The Supreme Court’s decision upholding all but three provisions of the milk code encourages us to be more creative in advocating breastfeeding as the best way to nourish our young.

By breastfeeding, we promote natural family planning where we emphasize birth spacing.

And it is the DOH, through the national nutrition council, that oversees the implementation of the hunger mitigation program.

Labis nating nadarama ang kalagayan ng ating mga kapus-palad. Ang pagwakas ng kahirapan ang ating pangunahing kinakailangang gawin sa kasalukuyan. Itinuturing ko ito bilang personal na pananagutan at tungkulin ng ating pamahalaan na bigyan ng dignidad at ginhawa ang bawat mamamayan sa ating bayan.

Ang kadakilaan ng pagtao ay hindi maaaring matamo kung ang sambayanan ay gutom at hikahos. Matibay nating hinahangad maibsan ang di-makatao, imoral, di-makatungan at di-magaling sa pangkabuhayang kahirapan.

And I’m glad that we’re making real progress in alleviating poverty. The incidence of extreme poverty is down, it’s below 10% for the first time in our history. (applause)

So, the people can be assured that we lead with a heavy hand to guide the nation. That we will not falter in keeping our hand on the tiller of the ship of state.

As we enter the holiday season, it’s essential that every person of means help those in need. Those of us in government should do everything in our power to be a catalyst for this process.

You–who are involved in infant and young child feeding are securing our country’s future, for tomorrow belongs to today’s child. And you cannot give the nation a better christmas gift than what you are giving now.

On behalf of the Filipino children, thank you. Merry christmas and best wishes for your continued success! (applause) Maraming salamat sa inyong lahat.
